response.answer: I take ownership of murky vendor incidents by separating verified contract facts from vendor claims, documenting the distinction clearly, and leading communications without overstating attribution. I wait for the ticket export before attributing fault, a discipline I adopted after correcting an earlier premature verbal attribution. When evidence changes the picture, I correct the record directly; I also address data issues at the source and maintain clear handover notes. For example, during a vendor outage I used separate fact-and-claim columns before owning communications, and the resulting statement passed legal review unchanged. This supports describing a careful, evidence-led approach rather than claiming I resolve every incident independently.
